# Ezekiel 13 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of man, prophesy against the-prophets-of Israel who-prophesy, and-say to-the-prophets from-their-own-heart, 'Hear [the]-word-of YHWH!'

**3** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Woe to-the-prophets, the-foolish-ones, who-follow their-own spirit and-what-they-have-not-seen!'

**4** Like-foxes in-ruins your-prophets have-been, O-Israel.

**5** You-have-not-gone-up into-the-breaches, and-you-have-not-built-up a-wall for-the-house-of Israel to-stand in-the-battle on-the-day-of YHWH.

**6** They-saw vanity and-divination-of-lies, the-ones-saying, 'Declares YHWH,' and-YHWH has-not-sent-them, and-they-wait for-[the]-confirmation-of [the]-word.

**7** Have-you-not-seen a-vision-of vanity, and-divination-of-lies have-you-not-spoken? And-you-say, 'Declares YHWH,' and-I — I-have-not-spoken."

**8** Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: "Because you-spoke vanity and-saw-a-lie, therefore behold-Me against-you," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**9** And-My-hand shall-be against the-prophets who-see vanity and-who-divine lies; in-the-council-of My-people they-shall-not-be, and-in-the-register-of the-house-of Israel they-shall-not-be-written, and-to the-land-of Israel they-shall-not-come; and-you-shall-know that I [am] the-Lord YHWH.

**10** Because, yes-because, they-led-astray My-people, saying, 'Peace!' — and-there-is no peace; and-one [is]-building a-wall, and-behold-them plastering-it [with]-whitewash.

**11** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**12** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**13** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**14** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**15** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**16** "And-the-wall plastered-with-whitewash shall-fall; and-I-will-bring-down upon-it rain flooding, and-you, hailstones great, shall-fall, and-a-wind-of storms shall-break-out."

**17** "And-you, son-of man, set your-face against the-daughters-of your-people, who-prophesy from-their-own heart, and-prophesy against-them.

**18** And-say, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Woe to-the-ones-sewing bands upon all joints-of-the-hands, and-making veils upon-the-head-of every stature to-hunt souls! The-souls you-hunt — [are they] the-souls-of My-people? And-the-souls for-yourselves you-keep-alive?

**19** And-you-profaned-Me among-My-people for-handfuls-of barley and-for-pieces-of bread, to-put-to-death souls which should-not-die and-to-keep-alive souls which should-not-live, by-your-lying to-My-people, the-ones-hearing lies.'

**20** "Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: I-will-tear your-bands and-deliver My-people from-your-hand, and-they-shall-not-be again in-your-hand for-prey; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

**21** "Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: I-will-tear your-bands and-deliver My-people from-your-hand, and-they-shall-not-be again in-your-hand for-prey; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

**22** "Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: I-will-tear your-bands and-deliver My-people from-your-hand, and-they-shall-not-be again in-your-hand for-prey; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

**23** "Therefore thus says the-Lord YHWH: I-will-tear your-bands and-deliver My-people from-your-hand, and-they-shall-not-be again in-your-hand for-prey; and-you-shall-know that I [am] YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **13:4**: Ke-shu'alim ba-choravot — 'like foxes in ruins.' False prophets exploit destruction rather than preventing it. They are scavengers, not shepherds.

- **13:10**: Shalom ve-ein shalom — 'Peace! and there is no peace.' The central indictment: false prophets tell people what they want to hear. The whitewash metaphor: cosmetic religion over structural rot.

- **13:18**: Kesatot / mispashot — 'bands' / 'veils.' These female prophets practice sympathetic magic — binding souls through physical objects. The exact rituals are debated but likely involve divination for hire.

— EMET
